title: Hood of Odin

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Hood of Odin is a DLC armor piece. It is only available for the early supporters of Valheim via a Steam code sent out in an email from Iron Gate Studios to those who signed up for the Valheim Beta. Check your email if you signed up!
The crafting recipe is unlocked once the player has discovered Leather scraps and Coal. The Hood of Odin is crafted at the Workbench.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: • The cape and hood can be spawned via commands, but cannot be equipped or upgraded without the DLC.

full_text:
Hood of Odin

Internal ID: HelmetOdin | Type: Head | Source: Workbench | Crafting Materials: Leather scraps x15, Coal x6 | Armor: 4 | Set Pieces: Odin Set

Introduction. Hood of Odin is a DLC armor piece. It is only available for the early supporters of Valheim via a Steam code sent out in an email from Iron Gate Studios to those who signed up for the Valheim Beta. Check your email if you signed up!
The crafting recipe is unlocked once the player has discovered Leather scraps and Coal. The Hood of Odin is crafted at the Workbench.

Notes. • The cape and hood can be spawned via commands, but cannot be equipped or upgraded without the DLC.
